title: When NGINX Plus or NGINX Open Source is configured to use the try_files and alias directives with a map variable,…
description: A vulnerability in NGINX Plus and NGINX Open Source occurs when configured with try_files and alias directives using a map variable, where certain regular expression captures can cause a segmentation fault in a worker process. This leads to unexpected termination of the worker process, affecting availability. There is no impact on confidentiality or integrity, and no control plane exposure. The vulnerability has a medium severity score of 5.3.
